title: PvZ adventure zombie-wave schedule and generation
scope: Adventure campaign levels 1-50. Challenge and survival modes have separate wave setup and are not represented as per-level campaign rows.

units.tick: One board/game update. Default frame time is 10 ms, so convert ticks to seconds by multiplying by 0.01; actual wall-clock duration may vary.
units.waveNumbers: One-based in this JSON; internal code wave indexes are zero-based.

initialDelay.description: Standard Adventure first-wave counter is 1800 ticks; first-time level 2 uses 5000; mini-boss levels 10, 20, and 30 override to 100. Tutorial and special setup can pause/override the counter.

regularBetweenWaveDelay.description: After a non-flag wave. Can be reduced: after at least 400 ticks, if the previous wave health is at/below a randomized 50%-65% threshold, remaining countdown is clamped to 200 ticks (about 2 seconds).

flagWaveBetweenDelay.description: Campaign flag interval; the 4500-tick counter is followed by a 750-tick huge-wave warning and about one more tick before spawning.

zombieBatch.description: At the wave timer reaching zero, Board::SpawnZombieWave iterates through that wave list and creates all listed zombies in the same update. There is no global fixed delay between every zombie in the batch; each zombie then has its own entry/movement behavior.

waveGeneration.completedAdventurePoints: floor(zeroBasedWaveIndex * 2 / 5) + 1, except level 5 uses the ordinary formula
waveGeneration.flagWave: Adds min(basePoints, 8) normal zombies plus one flag zombie, then scales remaining points by 2.5 before weighted picks.

pointMultipliers.levelsWithSpecificModes: Some special levels apply x2, x3, x4, or x6; see Board::PickZombieWaves.

waveGeneration.pickRule: While points remain, picks from level-allowed zombie types by weighted random selection; each pick subtracts that zombie type pointCost. Types also require firstWave eligibility, except special modes.
fixedCaveats: The final wave guarantees one of every eligible level zombie type that has not already been selected (Yeti excluded).
Newly introduced zombie types can have a guaranteed intro spawn in a midpoint/final wave; see guaranteedIntroZombieTypes.
Level 50 boss behavior is special/cutscene-driven; the normal candidate list is not a full boss script.
Bobsled team may be replaced by four normal zombies if the board cannot add a bobsled team.
waveGeneration.randomness: Exact count/type per wave is not a single fixed table. Wave lists are generated with weighted selection and are influenced by player ID, board random seed, level, and adventure completion state; the generated list is then saved.

levels.yetiMayBeIncludedConditionally: Only if CanSpawnYetis() allows it; Yeti is excluded from the final-wave missing-types guarantee.
